gyms.name: Pewter Gym
gyms.introText: Brock crosses his arms. 'I've been waiting, kid. I use FILE-type Bashmon. You'll need to know your ls and cat commands cold. Let's go!'
gyms.winText: Brock nods. 'Not bad. The Boulder Badge is yours. You've got what it takes to navigate any directory. Now go — Cerulean awaits.'

gyms.name: Cerulean Gym
gyms.introText: Misty tosses her hair. 'I prefer cute things — like my NETWORK Bashmon. But don't mistake cute for weak. Prepare yourself!'
gyms.winText: Misty hands over the Cascade Badge. 'You're better than I expected. Your file navigation is impressive. Keep pushing north!'

gyms.name: Vermilion Gym
gyms.introText: Lt. Surge cracks his knuckles. 'In the war, we used bash to coordinate strikes. Grep saved my life! Think you can match my search power?'
gyms.winText: Lt. Surge salutes. 'Pattern matched, soldier. The Thunder Badge is yours. grep is mightier than the sword!'

gyms.name: Celadon Gym
gyms.introText: Erika looks up from her book. 'Oh my, a challenger. My PROCESS-type Bashmon tend to run quietly in the background. Can you find them with ps?'
gyms.winText: Erika smiles softly. 'How elegant. The Rainbow Badge is yours. A calm mind and sharp ps skills will take you far.'

gyms.name: Fuchsia Gym
gyms.introText: Koga steps out of the shadows. 'The ninja monitors all network traffic unseen. My NETWORK Bashmon watch every packet. Ping me if you dare!'
gyms.winText: Koga bows. 'You have broken through my defenses. The Soul Badge is yours. Always encrypt your ssh, never curl into a pipe without checking.'

gyms.name: Saffron Gym
gyms.introText: Sabrina stares through you. 'I read your mind... you think you're ready. SYSTEM-type Bashmon operate at root level. Can you handle true power?'
gyms.winText: Sabrina's expression softens, barely. 'Impressive willpower. The Marsh Badge is yours. Root access is a responsibility — wield chmod with care.'

gyms.name: Cinnabar Gym
gyms.introText: Blaine strokes his mustache. 'My PROCESS Bashmon move like fire — chaining attacks in a pipeline. Can you out-grep a volcano?'
gyms.winText: Blaine claps. 'Ha! Hot stuff! The Volcano Badge is yours. The pipe operator is the most powerful tool in the terminal — never forget that!'

gyms.name: Viridian Gym
gyms.introText: Giovanni turns his chair slowly. 'So... you've come this far. I am Giovanni, leader of Team Rocket. I'll show you the true meaning of system control!'
gyms.winText: Giovanni stands. 'Hmm. You've defeated me... Take your Earth Badge. But this isn't over. The terminal always has more secrets to reveal.'
